clue.text: Who has a piano piece from Debussy conveying calmness?

parts.note: qui is French for 'who', in keeping with the French composer in the clue
Debussy wrote a set of Études for piano; an étude is a study piece

explanation.surface: Someone wonders who plays a peaceful Debussy piano work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from Debussy' hints at French throughout: the French for 'who' gives the first part, and Debussy's piano studies give the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Quietude is a literary word for stillness and tranquillity, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Feelings of unease when the Queen takes gifts

parts.note: Qu. is an abbreviation for queen
alms are charitable gifts to the poor

explanation.surface: People feel uneasy when the monarch accepts presents.
explanation.definitionFit: Qualms are pangs of doubt or misgiving.

clue.text: One who sets part of an author's work in order

definitions.text: One who sets part of an author's work in order

parts.words: One who sets part of an author's work in order
parts.note: seems to be an editor or typesetter, but the 'part' is the alphabetical list at the back of a book

explanation.surface: A publishing worker who arranges a writer's text.
explanation.walkthrough: The part of the book is the alphabetical list of topics at the end, which this person compiles.
explanation.definitionFit: An indexer compiles the index of a book, putting its entries in alphabetical order.

clue.text: I ram statue, out to shock

indicators.note: out signals that the letters are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to ram a statue to cause a shock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' is the anagram signal for I RAM STATUE.
explanation.definitionFit: To traumatise is to cause severe emotional shock.

clue.text: Cheated twin's angry over inheritance wasted ultimately

parts.note: a double is a twin or exact likeness
cross means angry

indicators.note: ultimately means take the last letters of these words

explanation.surface: A twin is furious that the inheritance was squandered in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' simply joins the pieces in this down clue; 'ultimately' takes the last letters of inheritance and wasted, ED.
explanation.definitionFit: To double-cross someone is to betray or cheat them.

clue.text: A number of grains companion found in whisky?

indicators.note: one piece is found inside the other, so the companion letters sit within the drink

parts.note: a dram is a small measure of whisky
CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: A puzzling question about how many grains go into a glass of whisky.
explanation.walkthrough: CH, for Companion of Honour (a British honour), goes inside DRAM, a tot of whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: A drachm is an old apothecaries' weight equal to sixty grains, so it is a fixed number of grains.

clue.text: Remarkable features in our area

indicators.note: features says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Our district has some remarkable features.
explanation.definitionFit: Rare means unusual and so out of the ordinary, remarkable.

clue.text: One bit smuggled into prisoner's room — not totally secure building!

indicators.note: the small pieces are slipped inside the shortened room
the room loses its final letter

parts.note: a prisoner is kept in a cell
I is the Roman numeral for one
a tad is a small bit

explanation.surface: Someone smuggles something into a prison cell, so the building is not fully secure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not totally' cuts CELL to CEL, and 'smuggled into' puts I and TAD inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A citadel is a fortress, a fortified building that protects a city.

clue.text: Reasonable way to gain speed

parts.note: a mode is a way or manner of doing things
rate means speed

explanation.surface: A sensible way to build up speed.
explanation.definitionFit: Moderate means within reasonable limits, not extreme.

clue.text: Tot needs father, first to last

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word for father is shifted to the end

parts.note: dad is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: A small child needs its father.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tot' looks like a toddler but is the verb meaning to sum up; DAD with its first D moved to the end becomes ADD.
explanation.definitionFit: To tot up figures is to total them, the same as adding them.

clue.text: Spoilt little Edward kept behind by grown-up a long time

indicators.note: the short name comes after, held behind the other pieces

parts.note: an adult is a grown-up
an era is a long period of time
Ted is a short form of Edward

explanation.surface: A grown-up keeps a child back for ages and spoils him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kept behind by' places TED after ADULT and ERA.
explanation.definitionFit: Adulterated food or drink has been contaminated or debased, so it is spoilt.

clue.text: Action on the pitch that could make bowler blower

definitions.text: Action on the pitch that could make bowler blower

parts.words: Action on the pitch that could make bowler blower
parts.note: sounds like cricket, but the pitch is musical, a change of key; swapping two letters of 'bowler' also gives 'blower'

explanation.surface: Something happening at a cricket match that turns a bowler into a blower.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a bowler plays on the pitch; here pitch is musical, and moving a key up or down is one sense, while swapping letters, as in bowler to blower, is another.
explanation.definitionFit: A transposition is moving music into another key, and also an exchange of letters' positions.

clue.text: Sententious comment I catch about emperor

parts.note: a maxim is a pithy, moralising saying

indicators.note: turned about, so the word for catch is read backwards

parts.note: to nail someone is to catch them

explanation.surface: A preachy remark about an emperor, someone catches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns NAIL to LIAN after MAXIM and I.
explanation.definitionFit: Maximilian was the name of several Holy Roman Emperors and of the Emperor of Mexico.

clue.text: Month for Topol and assembled actors to make a comeback

indicators.note: coming back means the drama school's initials are read in reverse

parts.note: RADA, the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art in London, brings actors together to train

explanation.surface: Topol and a cast of actors stage a return.
explanation.walkthrough: Topol was the Israeli actor famous as Tevye, so the month is a Jewish one; 'assembled actors' looks like a cast but is RADA, reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: Adar is a month of the Hebrew calendar, which an Israeli such as Topol would use.

clue.text: Set the style for a 24-hour period and pack up

definitions.text: Set the style for a 24-hour period
definitions.meaning: to style is to name, so this means give the 24 hours its name

explanation.surface: Someone names the day and then knocks off work.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means to stop working, and read literally names a period of 24 hours.

clue.text: Knocker of century slowing down — then 'on to one further century

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
rit. is the musical abbreviation for ritardando, slowing down
I is the Roman numeral for one
another C, a hundred

explanation.surface: A batsman slows down after a hundred and then goes on to another.
explanation.walkthrough: The cricket picture misleads: a century is a hundred runs, but here it is just C. 'Knocker' means someone who knocks, or disparages.
explanation.definitionFit: A critic is one who finds fault, and to knock something is to criticise it.

clue.text: Red mark on front of permit

indicators.note: the mark is placed in front of the word for permit

parts.note: a scar is a mark left on the skin
to let is to permit

explanation.surface: A red stain appears on the front of an official permit.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarlet is a bright shade of red.

clue.text: William is able to provide camping item

parts.note: Billy is a pet form of William
can means is able

explanation.surface: William is able to bring something along for a camping trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A billycan is a metal pot used for boiling water or cooking over a campfire.

clue.text: With painting technique I've got way beyond the ABC!

definitions.text: With painting technique I've got way beyond the ABC!

parts.words: With painting technique I've got way beyond the ABC!
parts.note: a painter boasting of progress past the basics: the speaker is past the letter O, far down the alphabet beyond A, B and C, and the whole names a way of laying on thick paint

explanation.surface: An art student boasts that their technique has gone far beyond beginner level.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue hints at a split into I'M PAST plus the letter O, which is well beyond A, B and C in the alphabet; the whole names thickly applied paint.
explanation.definitionFit: Impasto is the technique of laying paint on so thickly that brush or knife strokes stand out.

clue.text: As one who grows things, make preparations on ground lacking rain

parts.note: to plan is to make preparations

indicators.note: the word for rain is taken away from the word for ground

parts.note: terrain is ground or land

explanation.surface: A gardener prepares the ground during a dry spell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking rain' strips RAIN from TERRAIN, leaving TER; 'on' joins PLAN above it in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A planter is a person who plants, especially one who runs a plantation.

clue.text: He died, with others around, as a religious person

parts.note: ob. abbreviates Latin obiit, 'he (or she) died'

indicators.note: turned around, so the Latin for 'and others' is read backwards

parts.note: et al. abbreviates Latin et alii, 'and others'

explanation.surface: A man died surrounded by others, as a member of a religious order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' reverses ETAL to LATE, which follows OB.
explanation.definitionFit: An oblate is a lay person dedicated to religious life, often attached to a monastery.

clue.text: Mass holding down gold car cover

indicators.note: in a down clue the mass sits above and holds the gold beneath it

parts.note: a tonne is a unit of mass
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A heavy mass keeps the gold safe beneath a car cover.
explanation.definitionFit: A tonneau cover is a flexible cover over an open car or truck's rear seats or load bed.

clue.text: West's partner, with hearts, in highest bidding

indicators.note: these letters go inside the word for highest

parts.note: best can mean of the highest quality
in bridge, West partners East, abbreviated E
H is the bridge abbreviation for hearts

explanation.surface: At the bridge table, East bids hearts at the top level.
explanation.walkthrough: The bridge picture is apt for E and H, but 'bidding' is the definition in its sense of a command.
explanation.definitionFit: A behest is a command, so to act at someone's behest is to do their bidding.

clue.text: Metal rather soft for spearhead

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to spearhead is to go in front and guide

explanation.surface: A soft metal used for the point of a spear.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the soft heavy metal and a verb meaning to head or guide a campaign.

clue.text: Help when position is captured

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

indicators.note: the word for position takes the little word inside it

parts.note: a stance is a position or posture

explanation.surface: Someone calls for help as a position is taken by the enemy.
explanation.definitionFit: Assistance is help given to someone.

clue.text: Girl's name left off record

indicators.note: the letter for left comes off the record

parts.note: an annal is a historical record of one year

explanation.surface: A girl's name has been left out of the official record.
explanation.definitionFit: Anna is a common girl's first name.

clue.text: Like pressed flowers already fixed?

definitions.meaning: flowers that have been cut and then dried flat
decided in advance, settled beyond argument

explanation.surface: Pressed flowers that are already set in place.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase literally describes cut, dried flowers and idiomatically means settled beforehand.

clue.text: See you after the end of June

indicators.note: the word for you comes after that letter
the final letter of the month's name is taken

parts.note: ye is an old word for you

explanation.surface: A parting promise to meet again once June is over.
explanation.definitionFit: To eye something is to look at it, to see it.

clue.text: Emphatic refusal to embrace King and Country

indicators.note: the refusal wraps around the king's letter

parts.note: 'no way!' is a firm refusal
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Someone flatly refuses to swear loyalty to King and Country.
explanation.definitionFit: Norway is a country in Scandinavia.

clue.text: Simply doubled, though barely

parts.note: two words that each mean simply: 'only' as in only a child
the second word for simply: 'just' as in just a minute

explanation.surface: Something simply doubled, yet only by a hair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Simply doubled' asks for two different words both meaning simply, placed side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Only just means by a narrow margin, scarcely.
